title: VMM 100KM Ultra Marathon — legacy English distance page
claims: The legacy English 100km page lists 100.9 km with 5,500 m of elevation gain.
The legacy page gives a start time of 20:00 on Friday 19/9/2025 from Sapa Square, with bib collection 09:00-21:00 on Friday.
The legacy page gives cut-off times of 03:00 at CP Topas Ecolodge, 12:00 at CP3, 15:00 at CP4, 17:00 at CP5, 20:00 at CP6, 21:30 at CP7 and 00:00 at the finish.
The legacy page allows three bags — finish, CP2 and CP4 — handed in at the start line.
The legacy page badges the 100km as a 4-point ITRA race, an ITRA National League race, a 100K UTMB Index race and a Western States 2026 qualifying race.

The legacy course description runs over Ham Rong Mountain, a new route after CP M2, an alternative single-track climb to Mount Silverstone, the Ban Moi valley (CP M4), Topas Ecolodge, a river water station, Giang Ta Chai, CP1 at Lao Chai, an updated CP1-CP2 climb, CP3 at O Quy Ho, Cow Mountain, CP4 at Ta Phin, CP5 at 31 Bridge, Sau Chua, CP6 to CP7 and a second Mount Silverstone climb before the Topas Ecolodge finish.
The legacy page states that 100km entrants must be at least 18 on race day and must have completed at least one chip-timed 50km+ ultra mountain race.
